CREATE TABLE BRANDS ( ID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, CODE VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(500), ACTIVE BOOLEAN NOT NULL );
INSERT INTO BRANDS (ID, NAME, CODE, DESCRIPTION, ACTIVE) VALUES (1, 'Renault', 'RENAULT', 'Renault brand', TRUE), (2, 'Opel', 'OPEL', 'Opel brand', TRUE), (3, 'Skoda', 'SKD', 'Skoda brand', TRUE);
